FROM student st JOIN `user` u ON u.id = st.id WHERE u.role = 'STUDENT'
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.select:

ORDER BY
${orderBy} u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS id, u.login_name AS login_name, u.real_name AS real_name, st.tel AS tel, st.address AS address, st.grade AS grade FROM student st JOIN `user` u ON u.id = st.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.role = 'STUDENT' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (id, tel, address, grade) VALUES (#{id}, #{tel}, #{address}, #{grade})
